text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while taking a breather after 
completing her first three years in the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Trainer. Are you free this 
weekend?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could we be gathering materials in the 
mountains or at the sea? If so, it would 
require a decent amount of preparation. As 
I braced myself slightly—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Well then, let's head to our promised 
spot~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: A hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day of the hot springs trip 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Anyone hoooome~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, truth be told, this ryokan is... 
guess what...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The food is sooo buono~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So you see, today is a trip, but it's also 
training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll learn about tons of delicious foods, 
polish my skills, and get to making super 
buono meals! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right, doskoi, doskoiii!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All in all... there's still some time 
before dinner. Since we're here, we 
decided to hit the hot springs first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, so satisfied, so satisfied~. That 
was a lovely bath~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I think I might finally understand how 
Tsukune feels~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...And it's almost time to eat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course～. All steady and ready, let's 
head out～!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Waaah...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Appetizers, sashimi, local specialties, 
simmered dishes, steamed dishes, vinegared 
dishes, kamameshi, and clear soup...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa~~, it's so shiny~...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
“—Oops, we can't let it get cold! Let's 
dig in!”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's all so buono...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—...Even though this fish is just grilled 
with salt, it's sooo buono...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every single dish was exquisite, and the 
grilled items in particular were 
melt-in-your-mouth delicious.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It's probably slowly grilled over 
charcoal, and they're really particular 
about the salt too. Maybe it's Camargue 
salt...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what broth this soup uses~? 
Shiitake and... dried sardines, maybe? The 
vegetables are cut so beautifully too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unusually excited, she compared different 
broths while muttering to herself. And so, 
the night wore on—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*... I can't eat another bite...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Traditional inns are just bursting with 
happiness, aren't they~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The lavish spread of food had been 
completely and cleanly devoured.
choice_data_list: You really do love cooking, huh.
You really do love cooking, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I love it~! Eating it, making it, 
learning about it, I love all of it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, the more you learn about 
cooking, the more knowledge you realize is 
packed into it~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The traits of ingredients, the absorption 
rate of seasonings—all these little things 
stacking up lead to buono, which is what 
makes it so fun~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A famous one is like how adding seasonings 
in the order of sa-shi-su-se-so makes food 
tastier, right~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yep♪ You know, I was thinking...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want to cook lots of delicious, highly 
nutritious meals for the person special to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if those feelings were passed 
down with great care, and that's how 
things like 'Sa-Shi-Su-Se-So' were born~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, y'know, like the things my mom and dad 
taught me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want to cherish everything I learned at 
this inn today, keeping it close to my 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And so, to someone special—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want you to feel super buono and happy 
all the time, Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Cooking can bring so much happiness to 
someone precious to you, it's really 
amazing, isn't it~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Once I get home, I absolutely must master 
that pottery dish♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: 'Cause it's your favorite, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Maybe it's because we've always 
been together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Even if it doesn't show on your face, I 
can always tell when you're feeling Buono, 
Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Hishi Akebono...
